title: Foam Bear Melts Into Coffee, Then the Syrup Revives Him
caption:
POV: burnout hit so hard he melted into his coffee
A sleepy foam bear melts into a cold dark cup and disappears, until golden syrup drops fall from above and re-brew him into a happy steaming latte bear.
Best watched at night with the lights low - loop the tiny comeback and let it slow your evening down.
What's the little thing that brings you back when you're running on empty?
Save this for a tired night and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more tiny comebacks.
